senses.gloss: f. pl. ch. (v. תָּפַל; cmp. Syr. תפלתא indusium, Brockelm. p. 400) [attachment, hangings, cmp. טוֹטָפֶת,] T’fillin, the phylacteries tied on arm and head (Deut. VI, 8; XI, 18).
